basis: Written before any coach-hub drill attempt existed (no post-period data). Drilled: hedges as one habit (every hedge phrase: I guess, I think, maybe, kind of, ...; the hero habit) and the filler 'like' (the most frequent filler in the wearer's real English speech so far). Control: restarts, which the coach will never drill, so a change in restarts measures general drift in how the wearer talks rather than drill transfer.

drilled.why: hero habit: hedging a finished result or a commitment (all hedge phrases, counted together)
the most frequent filler in the wearer's real English speech

control.why: never drilled: separates drill transfer from general drift

cutover_rule: drilled habit: its first Bee-verified (counted) drill attempt; a drill on a specific hedge (e.g. 'I guess') counts toward 'hedges'. Control: the earliest first drill of any drilled habit. Sessions are Bee conversations by default (meeting captions only with source=all); drill attempts and voice notes never count.
note: Amended 2026-10-16 before any drill attempt (was: 'I guess' + 'like'); 'I guess' occurred once in 1,635 Bee words, too rare to measure. Do not edit after the first drill attempt. A habit drilled but not listed here is never reported as drilled; drilling the control habit invalidates it.
